title: Hardware-grant delivery + Ev_Stock_Arrived have no behavioral assertion
detail: Tick-scheduled grants (a NEW r2 feature) mutate inventory and emit Ev_Stock_Arrived, but no test asserts the event fires or the stock delta. Grep of *test*.odin for Stock_Arrived/.grants = empty.
recommended_fix: Add a test that runs to a grant.at_tick and asserts inventory.links/routers rose by the grant amount and Ev_Stock_Arrived fired.

title: Action-log tag-7 (Cmd_Place_Router) binary round-trip is field-unverified
detail: The round-trip test asserts field equality only for Draw_Pipe + Set_Pipe_Priority. The boot-wired keystone contains no Place_Router, so tag 7's write/read field fidelity is never exercised.
recommended_fix: Append a Cmd_Place_Router case to the round-trip switch (or place a router in the keystone) and assert type_idx + pos survive the byte round-trip.

title: Cmd_Place_Router has no end-to-end demo (validation is unit-pinned)
detail: demo_parse supports place_router, but grep of demos/ finds no demo using it. test_place_router_rules fully pins validation (rejects, consumes stock, spawns live node); the place-then-route integration has no E2E script.
recommended_fix: Add a demo that places a router mid-run and asserts packets route through it (golden captures the new junction).

title: Autopilot relay/port-reserve wiring has no behavioral assertion
detail: autopilot_tick is never invoked by any test (only autopilot_boot, smoke). determinism_test runs core testkit_autowire for live==replay but asserts no relay/midpoint/port-reserve behavior; a symmetric bug would pass.
recommended_fix: Add a test that spawns an unreachable node, runs autopilot_tick, and asserts it got wired through a relay with a port reserved.

title: snap_node tie-break-to-lower-id (E4) is untested
detail: E4 mandates ties break to the lower id; the branch is explicit. test_snap_inclusive_boundary uses a single node (boundary + past-radius only) and never sets up two equidistant nodes to exercise the tie-break.
recommended_fix: Add a fixture with two nodes equidistant from the query point and assert snap_node returns the lower id.

title: triage_map W6 label/value name-resolution has no regression pin
detail: The W6 fix resolves button values by class NAME to prevent the stream/email swap, but no test pins that the 'stream' label maps to the streaming class index. A catalog reorder could re-swap silently.
recommended_fix: Add a test calling triage_map and asserting values[2] == streaming class index and values[1] == email index.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 determinism spine ~100%. P1 ~88% (inventory/health/QoS/flow/driver pinned; gaps: grants+Ev_Stock_Arrived unasserted, action-log tag-7 Place_Router round-trip field-unverified). node-health & queue-overflow tests are REAL pins. --soak NONE (inherent, dev-only). Overall ~88%.
recommended_fix: Assert Ev_Stock_Arrived + grant stock delta at the scheduled tick; add Cmd_Place_Router to the action-log round-trip switch. Raises P1 to >=90% -> PASS.
